import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price_usd, colored by sensor_type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k',
                palette='deep', markers={0: 'X', 1: 'o'}, s=100, edgecolor='w', alpha=0.7)

# Add plot details
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video', loc='upper left', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True)
